rules.summary: Generate prototype assets only below /Game/UI/AIPrototype.
Use umg_ai_* for prototype screens; explicit child-widget assets may use uw_ai_* for an analyzed local Designer mode. Legacy umg_ai_* children retain FillScreen.
Create the actual Widget Blueprint at the validated /Game/UI/UMG system path with the formal project name.
Native UMG controls are temporary placeholders until project component mappings are supplied.

Represent image-derived geometry with normalized rectangles inside the reference frame. Explicit trial source-target-coordinates/1 binds target rectangles and Slots separately from unchanged raw source observations.

Author every complete NextGame system screen on the unified 2560x1440 design canvas and remap source-image geometry instead of preserving a smaller inner frame. Trial coordinate contracts require one uniform content-frame transform or per-node accepted design-derived geometry.

Resolve prototype mode from actual asset.name and production/formal mode from the formal target. Every resolved umg_* basename uses FillScreen; only uw_* may execute analyzed Desired, with missing/unknown values falling back to FillScreen. Desired content may use an explicit versioned executable layout dependency; planned minima never claim actual measurement.
Declare each adaptation axis from semantic ownership; distinguish reference framing and device safe insets and verify margins/movement beyond anchor enums.
Declare VerticalBox and HorizontalBox child Size, Padding, and both alignments, and GameScrollBox child Padding and both alignments; keep main-axis Size Auto/Fill independent from alignment Fill.
Choose decorative-image horizontal and vertical adaptation from its owning region and actual parent Slot; do not default local or screen decoration to a top-left Canvas anchor.

Allow localization-sensitive text, backgrounds, and decorations to expand together through flow layout or adaptive Slot relationships. Deliberately bounded Canvas wrapping may use the closed bounded-wrap/1 capacity declaration; it never proves actual text fit.
Use the required Btn structural trigger surface; native Button styling, focus behavior, and event hookup remain placeholders until their project mappings are supplied.

Give each discrete interaction a Btn owner; preserve its accepted visual descendants and direct-parent Slot while keeping independent region headings and help inputs under their own owners. Separate parentage from drawing order and leave behavior to project code.

When child GameImages or state branches express a Button's visual states, explicitly set its WidgetStyle Normal, Hovered, and Pressed brushes to None/NoDrawType so the Button draws no duplicate layer.
Use a center-point, auto-sized Canvas slot with Center justification and SelfHitTestInvisible visibility for a short single-line Button label centered by the Button.
Set every non-interactive component to Not Hit-Testable (Self Only) while preserving descendant input.
Set Is Variable on every WidgetTree component that project code must read, modify, populate, show, hide, or otherwise control at runtime; leave fixed decoration unexposed.
Treat image-recognized text as temporary copy pending localization rules.

Map every visual.image node to /Script/UIFramework.GameImage with the Img prefix; never create native /Script/UMG.Image in new assembly work. Map declared positive Brush image dimensions during the layout baseline and preserve unrelated Brush fields.
Keep item-specific state markers under their accepted local owner and preserve shared popup boundaries; declare group exclusivity only with evidence.
Verify source frame and imported resource identity, Brush dimensions, parent allocation and effective transforms; unknown actual geometry remains unverified.
Derive slice cuts from source-frame protected art, permitted stretch axes and consistent Brush scale; reject targets that cannot preserve the caps.
Review every scoped TextBlock including hidden and unchanged text; retain effect and parameter uncertainty, inspect locally, and annotate only remaining ambiguity.
Give joined content-driven surfaces one width authority, account for visible insets and prevent desired-size cycles; verify short and long title/body combinations.
Compare geometry and resource-scale relationships within explicitly declared visual families and preserve evidenced member exceptions.

Represent one recognized complete non-text graphic with one GameImage or one verified shared-widget realization; treat a Backplate and fixed glyph as separate complete groups when their duties differ, and retain same-graphic layers only for an accepted independent responsibility.
Keep TextBlock content textual; represent icons, separators, and decorative graphics with GameImage components.
Create one TextBlock for each independently bounded text block instead of combining unrelated rows or labels.
Declare source fontSizeUnit; preserve source px and lower at 96 DPI to compensated positive even Slate points. Legacy pt semantics remain unchanged.
Explicitly set every TextBlock foreground color, including white labels; never rely on a default or a containing widget's color.
Require a positive Wrap Text At for wrapping; preserve independently accepted native Auto Wrap, Slot width and Size To Content decisions.
Lower justification, anchors, alignment, width and auto-size jointly; increasing text capacity must not move its accepted stable center or growth edge.
Represent a runtime current/maximum value as a HorizontalBox containing independent variable current and maximum TextBlocks plus one static '/' TextBlock in declared order.
For every fullHeight screen shell or background marker, preserve vertical Canvas stretch and disabled auto-size through its complete Canvas ancestor chain, then verify a taller preview.

Prefer a content-driven Canvas module when appropriate; accepted exact-axis SizeBox constraints require explicit versioned enable/clear semantics, child Slot, native setter execution, and actual readback. Planned dependency lower bounds are never measured Desired Size.
Represent repeated image elements as explicit prototype nodes pending project ListView conventions.
Represent a runtime-variable collection with LuaListView or LuaTileView and bind its EntryWidgetClass to a separate entry Widget Blueprint.

Declare whether the collection shows all entries by growing or keeps a deliberate fixed viewport; for show-all collections, preserve stable-axis constraints and enable Size To Content on the nearest Canvas child.

When the collection node is a LuaTileView, create its gaps through positive Entry Width and Entry Height relative to the visible entry footprint; keep Horizontal and Vertical Entry Spacing zero/default because they contract inward.
Create one runtime collection entry as a child Widget Blueprint derived from UIFramework.ListViewItem.
Materialize the entry referenceSize in the first structural Panel Slot; reject zero-offset full-stretch roots and SizeBox-only root sizing.
Configure LuaListView or LuaTileView as a data-driven leaf using its verified project properties, sizing contract, and ListViewItem entry relationship.
Recognize cohesive image regions and place each under an appropriate structural container instead of flattening content into the root.
Use Overlay only for deliberate layering, adaptive shared bounds, or independent alignment; allow Button to own CanvasPanel directly and remove redundant Button-to-Overlay-to-Canvas chains.
Declare both OverlaySlot alignments on every direct Overlay child and use Fill on both axes for complete-region layers. Preserve declared finite four-edge Overlay Padding and verify it after save.
Prefix each mapped WidgetTree component instance name according to its concrete component type; generated or mismatched names are review warnings rather than build blockers.

For non-Fight systems keep regions and screen-local collections in semantic Panels/leaves; extract child assets only for evidenced entry-widget-class, runtime-template, reusable-widget, or explicit system boundaries. Fight remains the stricter integration-shell exception.

Create or reuse /Game/UI/UMG/<SystemFolder> matching the logical system token by case only, or explicitly declare systemFolderInstance version 1 for its exact dated and numbered system-scoped destination; project-common cannot opt in.
Name system screens umg_<system>[_<subsystem>] and omit absent optional segments.
Name functional child widgets uw_<system>[_<subsystem>]_<function>[_<secondary_function>].
Create or reuse /Game/UI/UMG/<SystemFolder>/Widgets and store functional child Widget Blueprints there.
Use /Game/UI/UMG/Fight/umg_fight as the authoritative fight integration reference; do not use umg_fight1.
Keep umg_fight as an integration/layout shell; functional features must be independent child Widget Blueprints, with layout-only panels allowed.
Create fight feature modules under /Game/UI/UMG/Fight/Widgets as uw_fight_* assets and integrate required top-level modules into umg_fight.
Build the magazine as a four-column show-all LuaTileView with a width-only SizeBox constraint and Existing, Incoming, and Empty entry states.
Use the observed umg_fight module tree and anchor distribution as reference evidence without copying offsets blindly.
